ELY-Open-Source/CrychicUI.body:
# CrychicUI

A Go component library for MyGo's native UI. It keeps MyGo's own look: a zinc gray background, the system accent color, 6 DIP corner radius, a 4 DIP spacing unit, and the system font. Every component moves, and every interactive component has a synthesized sound effect.

The interface is drawn by MyGo on the GPU, without HTML, JavaScript, or WebView.

## Installation

```sh
go get github.com/ELY-Open-Source/CrychicUI
```

Requires Go 1.27.1 and MyGo v0.5.5.

## Sound

Interactive components play a sound effect on action, enabled by default.

```go
sound.SetEnabled(false) // mute all
```

## Gallery

```sh
go run ./cmd/gallery
```

The same program compiled to WebAssembly is the website: https://crychicui.zhangyanghaha0407.workers.dev

## License

MIT. Third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/ELY-Open-Source/CrychicUI/blob/HEAD/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Table of Contents

- [Project Overview](#项目简介)

## Project Overview

This project collects and compiles multicast and unicast source information for Zhejiang Telecom IPTV from the internet, along with lists in `.m3u`, `.txt`, and `.csv` formats and channel logos.

> ⚠️ Special notice: All content in this project is collected and compiled from the internet. It is intended only for compiling lists of programs launched on Telecom IPTV. The accuracy of all content is not guaranteed and is provided for reference only. The unicast and multicast addresses provided are for format reference only. To actually watch, you must purchase China Telecom IPTV service and play it using the included set-top box.

## Channel Resolution and Availability Reports

This project periodically collects channel resolution and availability data from the internet and provides reports:

- [Zhejiang Multicast Source Detection Report](https://myepg.org/Zhejiang_Multicast/report.html)
- [Zhejiang Unicast Source Detection Report](https://myepg.org/Zhejiang_Unicast/report.html)

## Project File Description

#### Zhejiang Multicast (Zhejiang_Multicast):

- `Zhejiang_Multicast.m3u`: m3u list using local logos.
- `Zhejiang_Multicast_OL.m3u`: m3u list using online logos.
- `Zhejiang_Multicast.txt`: Channel list in txt format.
- `Zhejiang_Multicast.csv`: Channel inventory.

#### Zhejiang Unicast (Zhejiang_Unicast):

- `Zhejiang_Unicast.m3u`: m3u list using local logos.
- `Zhejiang_Unicast_OL.m3u`: m3u list using online logos.
- `Zhejiang_Unicast.txt`: Channel list in txt format.
- `Zhejiang_Unicast.csv`: Channel inventory.

#### Link-Format Lists

```
https://myepg.org/api/subscribe/{source}/{type}
```

##### Parameter Description:

| Parameter | Example Value | Required | Description |

| `source` | `multicast` or `unicast` | Yes | Data source type, multicast or unicast |
| `type` | `m3u` or `txt` | Yes | Output file format |
| `udpxy` | `10.30.0.1:2340` | Required for multicast | Format is IPv4:port |

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

## 🚀 What's new in v6.0

The main change: **every link is now actually parsed**, rather than checked with regexes against the raw string. Percent-encoding is decoded, `&` and `\u0026` are repaired, parameter synonyms are reduced to one name. Everything that previously passed as "unreadable — therefore fine" is now rejected.

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before checking
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with a lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecure flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out legitimate configs

### 🌐 Addresses and protocols

- ✅ **`ipaddress` instead of regex** — 169.254/16, 100.64/10, 198.18/15,…

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily football match analysis for 竞彩, football odds and handicap interpretation; 足彩
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotion aside and watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validate market movements across three channels. No bets at low odds, and no entry when the signal is unclear. Automatic execution before matches, automatic settlement after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, with historical dates archived for review at any time
- Covers 500 to 1300+ matches per day (full 竞彩 and Asian handicap coverage), automatically flagging signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Skipped

We tried **models**: piled on parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model just recited prices the market had already set. No matter how many parameters, it could not produce anything new.

We tried **studying the market makers**: guessing at the bookmakers' moves, and the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoia. In the end it became clear that guessing the bookmaker is less useful than watching the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, motivation, form. Each one sounded convincing, and each had already been priced into the odds. However lively the talk, the handicap does not accept it.

With the detours behind us, one plain principle remains:

> **Follow where the money goes, and the handicap will speak.**
> But people watching the board get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing upsets, shaking at the last minute. You can tell at a glance that emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to the machine, and people keep only one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 (European odds)** tracks market-wide odds movements: who has been collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks lines and water levels: sudden pivots near kickoff, and sniping on the upper side. The money is real cash slammed down, more honest than anything said aloud.

**Over/Under** tracks the total goals line. Once a goal-rich setup appears, the number of goals in the match has often already been foreshadowed.

Each of the three informants has their own news. When the news matches, the referee dares to make the call. **Matches where they disagree (European odds and Asian handicap contradicting each other) are left alone entirely.** If the informants are already arguing with each other, why bet at all?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything that remains is discipline:

- **No bets at low odds**: single-choice odds below 1.5, or double-choice odds reduced below 1.3, will not be bought however good the signal is. At odds that low, even a win earns little money.
- **No entry without a clear signal**: no signal, conflicting signals, or an ambiguous direction means waiting. Missing a bet costs nothing; betting wrong loses money.
- **Quality determines stake**: the firmer the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Automatic betting 15 minutes before kickoff, automatic settlement when results come in**: no shaky hands at the last minute, and no urge to raise stakes after a win or chase losses after a defeat.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Buy lottery tickets only at licensed physical outlets. Persons under 18 may not participate.

issac-new/SwarmStudio.body:
# SwarmStudio
This project is based on the author's idea and was 100% completed by AI, containing no human-written code. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license. For referenced upstream projects, if you need to deploy them at runtime, please comply with their license terms, or refer to them yourself to migrate features and complete a localized implementation.

Hard times create human code, humen code create ai times, ai times create weak men, and weak men create hard times。

> A desktop **AI collaboration center** application secondarily developed based on [hermes-studio](https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio). This repository is an overlay (secondary development layer), which layers custom features onto the upstream through build-time injection; the upstream source code always remains clean and can be upgraded independently.

SwarmStudio brings three types of work, "human collaboration partners + local Agent clusters + human-AI collaboration," together under a single cockpit (Cockpit) for unified coordination. It offers a focused overview of the big picture, and can also engage with specific tasks for supplementing / evaluating / deciding / approving. It also provides a collaboration board, Matrix instant messaging, and end-to-end observability of runs. It meets the organizational development needs of AI collaboration.

---

## Why SwarmStudio Is Needed

As AI collaboration moves from "a single machine with a single Agent" to "multiple people + multiple Agents working in parallel," existing tool forms begin to fail. SwarmStudio offers answers to three structural dilemmas:

- **Three types of work are fragmented**: human collaboration partners (Matrix / Slack / WeChat), local Agent clusters (Claude Code terminal, model APIs), and 1:1 human-AI collaboration (chat-box approvals) are scattered across different interfaces, cannot be coordinated, and switching costs are extremely high. SwarmStudio uses Cockpit to bring all three into the same cockpit.
- **Linear chat streams cannot represent multi-Agent collaboration**: multi-agent parallelism / spawning (a main agent launching subagents) / convergence (aggregating multi-agent results) get interleaved and lost in a linear message stream. SwarmStudio uses an Evidence Graph to restructure the entire run process, making parallelism / spawning / convergence clear at a glance.
- **AI run processes lack observability and traceability**: reasoning chains are black boxes, tool calls have no timing, subagent hierarchies are flat, and cross-machine collaboration has no trace. SwarmStudio's RunTraceView makes every reasoning step traceable, replayable, and exportable, meeting compliance audit scenarios (finance / healthcare / legal).
- **Upstream secondary development easily falls into a "forking quagmire"**: heavy changes after forking make the upstream impossible to upgrade. SwarmStudio uses an overlay injection architecture (Class A purely additive + Class B patches) so that the `.git` of the three upstream repositories is never polluted and they can be upgraded independently via `git pull`.

mango6i/iOSForge.description: Build IPA and .deb, .dylib plugins online in the cloud without a Mac; supports iOS 15+
mango6i/iOSForge.body:
# iOSForge

A GitHub build tool for projects targeting iOS 15.0 and above. Source code lives on GitHub, builds run on a macOS Runner, and outputs can be `.dylib`, `.deb`, or `.ipa`.


[Web workbench](https://mango6i.github.io/iOSForge/)

## What you can do with it

- Compile your own rootless dynamic library plugins using Theos/Logos;
- Generate `.deb` when you need a plugin package;
- Compile `.ipa` from your own Xcode project without a certificate, to be handled by TrollStore or a self-signing tool; the Apple certificate export mode is also retained;
- On the same web page, upload source ZIP files or folders, trigger builds, view recent builds, and directly download or delete the real IPA, DEB, and DYLIB files.

## Simplest way to use it

**Each person uses their own personal repository.** The web page no longer pre-fills the author's `mango6i/iOSForge` by default. Before operating, use the Token to verify the current account, repository ownership, and visibility; organization and cross-account collaborative repositories are not yet supported. For private source code, set up a separate **Private repository**; a public repository will make its source public even if it belongs to you. Uploading to a public repository from the web page requires an additional confirmation of the public risk.

First-time use: [download the clean starter package](https://mango6i.github.io/iOSForge/downloads/iosforge-starter.zip) → extract → create your own Private repository → commit all contents of the package (including `.github/`) to the repository root → enable Actions → create a Token authorized only for that repository → return to the workbench, fill in your repository, and click “Check my repository”. For the full steps, see the [personal repository setup guide](https://mango6i.github.io/iOSForge/guide.html#own-repository). The starter package is generated from an explicit file manifest and contains only build tools and configuration; it does not include `sources/`, other users' projects, test examples, credentials, or commit history.

Your own private build repository does not need GitHub Pages enabled, and you do not need to fork the author's entire repository. A private repository reduces the risk of public leaks, but it cannot rule out risks from untrusted code or dependencies, collaborators, browser extensions, or token leaks. Code that was previously pushed to a public repository will not disappear from public history because of this. GitHub Actions uses the quota of the account that owns the repository.

Open the [web workbench](https://mango6i.github.io/iOSForge/), and follow the second item, the [usage guide](https://mango6i.github.io/iOSForge/guide.html), step by step to prepare and build. You can also go to the repository's **Actions → GitHub Actions → Run workflow** and choose:

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

weifuwan/yak-ops.body:
# Yak Ops

Build, move, and operate data with confidence.

Yak Ops is a data platform for data integration and synchronization scenarios. The current `main` branch is still under development: Task Definition and YakFlow Core / Runtime / Connectors exist independently, and product-side synchronous execution has not yet been reconnected. For the capabilities of published versions, see the corresponding Release.

## Build and Run

Running the Distribution requires Java 21, along with a metadata database connection and a Datasource Master Key.

```sh
# Docker Compose, with built-in metadata database
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env as described below, then start
docker compose up -d
```

When using an empty database for the first time, set `YAK_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED=true` and a separate strong password `YAK_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD` in `.env`. After startup succeeds and the administrator is created, change the switch back to `false` and redeploy. Environments that already have user data should keep it disabled. Initialization may not be enabled unless an administrator password is configured.

In non-local environments, you must change the example database password and set a new `YAK_OPS_DATASOURCE_MASTER_KEY`. To use an external database, you can choose `compose.without-mysql.yaml`. Both deployment methods use `YAK_DATABASE_*` to connect to the metadata database.

The official Distribution is `yak-ops-{version}.tar.gz`. After extracting it, start it with `./bin/run-yak-ops.sh`.

# Maodouchat

Maodouchat (毛豆聊天) is an end-to-end encrypted Android instant messaging app: Jetpack Compose client + Ktor backend. It covers one-on-one and group chats, posts, audio and video calls, Signal protocol E2EE, encrypted attachments, optional AI capabilities, and an admin console.

For the feature list and completeness status, see [`docs/feature-inventory.md`](https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat/blob/HEAD/docs/feature-inventory.md). For the Bot API, see [`docs/bot-developer-api.md`](https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat/blob/HEAD/docs/bot-developer-api.md).

| Layer | Technology |
|----|------|
| Client | Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room + SQLCipher, WorkManager |
| Real-time | WebSocket `/ws` + REST fallback |
| Encryption | libsignal-client (1:1 sessions + group Sender Key), attachments AES-256-GCM |
| Calls | WebRTC (1:1 + group mesh), TURN short-term credentials |
| Server | Ktor, Exposed, JWT, PostgreSQL |
| Deployment | Docker Compose (Caddy + Postgres + server) |

## Requirements

- **JDK 21**: Required by this repository's Gradle build. Do not run Gradle with JDK 25.
- Android Studio / Android SDK, with `compileSdk = 37`.

xituimao/spider-clash.description: One-click silent fetching of free nodes
xituimao/spider-clash.body:
# Spider Clash 🕸️

A lightweight Node.js crawler for fetching, validating, and generating Clash/V2Ray subscription links.

## Features

- ✅ **Multi-source fetching**: Extracts nodes from subscription links or web pages.
- ✅ **Automatic validation**: Built-in TCP Ping validation automatically removes invalid nodes.
- ✅ **GitHub Actions**: Uses free compute to automatically update nodes and generate permanent subscription links.
- ✅ **Clash/V2Ray**: Automatically generates standard YAML and Base64 format configurations.

## How to Use (GitHub Actions Version) - **Recommended**

This is the simplest and most stable way to use it, and it requires no server of your own.

### 1. Fork This Project
Click the **Fork** button in the top right corner to copy the project to your account.

### 2. Configure Subscription Sources
Edit the `src/config.js` file and fill in your subscription source URLs:
```javascript
export default {
    sources: [
        'https://你的订阅链接1...',
        'https://你的订阅链接2...'
    ],
    // ...
}
```

### 3. Enable Permissions (Critical Step!)
On your GitHub repository page:
1. Click **Settings** > **Actions** > **General**
2. Scroll down to **Workflow permissions**
3. Select **Read and write permissions**
4. Click Save

### 4. Start Running
1. Click the **Actions** tab.
2. Select **Update Subscription** in the left sidebar.
3. Click **Run workflow** to trigger it manually once.
4. After that, it runs automatically twice a day (8:00 and 20:00 Beijing time).

### 5. Get Your Subscription Links
After a successful run, the subscription files are automatically updated in the `output` folder. You can use the **jsDelivr CDN** to accelerate them as your subscription address:

- **Clash subscription**:
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<你的用户名>/<仓库名>@main/output/clash.yaml`
  
- **V2Ray/general subscription**:
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<你的用户名>/<仓库名>@main/output/subscribe.txt`

---

## Local Development

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Single run
npm run crawl

# Run tests
npm test
```
